save_conversations: save a list of dialog episodes to a JSONL file with metadata using Conversations.save_conversations
load_conversations: load and iterate through dialog episodes from a JSONL file using the Conversations class
read_metadata: read and display conversation metadata like date, speakers, and options using Conversations.read_metadata
save_metadata: save conversation metadata to a JSON file using Metadata.save_metadata with opt and speaker info
iterate_turns: iterate through individual turns in a single dialog episode using the Conversation class
